audit.whatIsWrong: Wind Wall was described only by its 4-second duration; its cooldown appeared nowhere in either layer.
audit.why: Wind Wall is 25/23/21/19/17. Twenty-five seconds at rank 1 is the largest exploitable window in the lane — 'wait the 4s out' tells you when the wall ends but not that you then own the next twenty seconds.
audit.corrected: Every wall reference now carries 25s at rank 1 alongside the 4s duration.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike treated Perfect Execution as just another commit without saying why the wall does not stop it.
audit.why: Perfect Execution is a dash, not a projectile — Wind Wall cannot block it. That is precisely why level 6 is your spike against a champion who otherwise blanks your ranged kit, and it was never said.
audit.corrected: Level 6 spike and whys[4] now state that the wall stops your Q and E but never your R dash.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every wall reference talked only about the Q kunai; nothing said Shuriken Flip is also blocked, and the Way of the Wanderer shield never appeared.
audit.why: Shuriken Flip is flagged as a projectile in Riot's kit — the wall eats it, which denies the mark AND the recast dash, so your whole engage disappears, not just your poke. Separately his passive builds a shield whenever he is moving, which absorbs the opening of your burst.
audit.corrected: Added that Wind Wall blocks the E shuriken and kills the mark-and-dash, and added the passive shield to the late-game text.

edits.before: Yasuo's Windwall (W) eats your Five Point Strike kunai outright, so never fan Q into a raised wall — wait the 4s out or angle the cast around it, since you have no Shroud and only Q to trade with yet.
edits.after: Yasuo's Wind Wall (W) eats your Five Point Strike AND your Shuriken Flip — both are projectiles — so never throw into a raised wall. It is 25s at rank 1, so wait it out or angle the cast around it.

edits.before: Perfect Execution comes online — E the shuriken to mark him, dash in, then R cast one through him and cast two re-dashes to execute on missing health; land it before he can airborne you with R off a tornado.
edits.after: Perfect Execution comes online — E the shuriken to mark him, dash in, then R cast one through him and cast two re-dashes to execute on missing health. Your R is a dash, so no wall stops it; only your E and Q get blocked.

edits.before: Once Yasuo has 2+ crit items plus Windwall, his sustained crit DPS outlasts your single E-Q-R burst — if it doesn't kill, his wall blanks the kunai follow-up and he runs you down.
edits.after: Once Yasuo has 2+ crit items plus Wind Wall, his sustained crit DPS outlasts your burst and his passive shield eats the front of it — if the combo doesn't kill, he runs you down.

edits.before: Bait or wait out his 4s Windwall, then E-dash in for the empowered-auto-Q-passive all-in while his W is down
edits.after: Bait or wait out Wind Wall, 25s at rank 1, then E-dash in for the empowered-attack-Q all-in while it is down

edits.before: Raise Windwall to block your Q kunai and deny the ranged poke that fuels your passive ring
edits.after: Raise Wind Wall to block both your Q kunai and your E shuriken, killing the mark and the dash

edits.before: Yasuo's Windwall (W) is the whole early problem — it blocks your Five Point Strike kunai cold for its full duration, so don't fan Q into a raised wall or you're left energy-starved with nothing back. You have no Twilight Shroud yet and only Q at Level 1, so concede the first few levels: last-hit at Q range, eat his double-Q poke, and don't walk into his tornado window. The upside is he can't kill you here either as long as you respect the wall and don't burn E chasing a dash he can refresh through minions.
edits.after: Yasuo's Wind Wall (W) is the whole early problem — it blocks your Five Point Strike kunai AND your Shuriken Flip, since both are projectiles, so a raised wall deletes your poke and your engage at once. It runs 4s and comes back every 25s at rank 1, so the punish is to bait it and own the next twenty seconds. You have no Twilight Shroud yet and only Q at Level 1, so concede: last-hit at Q range, eat his double-Q poke, and don't burn E chasing a dash he refreshes through minions.

edits.before: This is where you find your footing. Once you have Twilight Shroud (W), drop it to break his target lock, dodge Q-poke, and reset trades, then punish him with empowered-passive autos off your spell rings when he steps up to farm. At 6 your R is the equalizer: E to mark him, dash in, cast one through him, then cast two re-dashes to execute on missing health — fire it while his Windwall is down and before he can tornado-R you airborne. This Level 6-into-Lich-Bane stretch is your strongest window, so force the all-in here, not later.
edits.after: This is where you find your footing. Once you have Twilight Shroud (W), drop it to break his target lock, dodge Q-poke, and reset trades, then punish him with empowered attacks off your spell rings when he steps up to farm. At 6 your R is the equalizer, and the reason is mechanical: Perfect Execution is a dash, so Wind Wall cannot stop it. E to mark him while the wall is down, dash in, cast one through, then cast two to execute. This Level 6-into-Lich-Bane stretch is your strongest window, so force it here.

edits.before: You have only Q and no Shroud, and his Windwall blocks your kunai while he out-pokes you with double-Q — concede and last-hit at range.
edits.after: You have only Q and no Shroud, and Wind Wall blocks your kunai for 4s every 25s while he out-pokes you with his double-Q tornado.

edits.before: Still no Shroud to reset, and any Q you throw can be walled — trade with empowered autos off your spell rings, not committed kunai.
edits.after: Still no Shroud to reset, and Wind Wall blanks your Q and your E alike — trade with empowered attacks off your spell rings.

edits.before: At 6 your E-dash plus R's two-cast missing-health execute runs him down — fire it while Windwall is down and before his tornado-R lands.
edits.after: At 6 your E-dash plus R's two-cast execute runs him down — R is a dash, so no wall stops it; fire it before his tornado-R lands.

edits.before: He out-scales hard: 2+ crit items plus Windwall outlast your single burst rotation, so close early and let your team handle late Yasuo.
edits.after: He out-scales hard: 2+ crit items, a passive shield and Wind Wall outlast your single burst rotation, so close the lane early.

edits.before: Shroud his EQ — Q-poke, R-reset his all-in. Akali wins the Last Breath cooldown windows.
edits.after: Wind Wall eats your Q and E but never your R — poke around it. Akali wins the wall gaps.

edits.before: - Yasuo Last Breath: matchup-defining — His all-in after knockup. Reset out of it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Yasuo Wind Wall, 25s at rank 1: matchup-defining — it blocks both your Q kunai and your E shuriken, but never your R dash. - Last Breath, 70s at rank 1: it needs you Airborne first. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: His all-in after knockup. Reset out of it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Wind Wall, 25s at rank 1, blocks your Q and E but never your R dash. Bait it.

notes: The entry knew Wind Wall blocks Five Point Strike but never noticed it also blocks Shuriken Flip — Riot flags both as projectiles — which means a raised wall removes your engage, not just your poke. Conversely Perfect Execution is a dash and passes the wall, which is the actual mechanical reason level 6 is your spike. Neither layer gave Wind Wall's 25s rank-1 cooldown.
